recommendation.thresholdSummary: Action threshold crossed: wind chill −24°F during bus-stop hours
recommendation.explanation: An Extreme Cold Warning is in effect with wind chills near −24°F between 5 and 8 AM, when 610 students would be waiting at bus stops. Roads are clear and the building has heat, so the hazard is exposure rather than travel. A remote learning (AMI) day keeps instruction going without putting students outdoors.
recommendation.whatCouldChange: Wind chills forecast above −20°F by 6 AM would support a delayed start. A heating or power failure in the building would support a full closure.

alternatives.note: Wind chill is still below the cutoff at 9 AM, so a 2-hour delay does not clear it.
Defensible, but uses a make-up day when instruction can continue remotely.
Exposes bus riders to frostbite risk in under 30 minutes.

alerts.headline: Dangerously cold wind chills as low as 26 below zero. Frostbite possible on exposed skin in as little as 30 minutes.

roads.detail: All monitored routes near the school report clear, dry pavement.
